SELECT p.place_id AS placeId, p.name AS name, p.category AS category, p.latitude AS latitude, p.longitude AS longitude,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN t.name IN
#{tag}
THEN pt.confidence ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS preferredTagScore,
0 AS preferredTagScore,
COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN t.name IN
#{banTag}
THEN pt.confidence ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS banTagScore,
0 AS banTagScore,
GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT CASE WHEN t.name IN
#{tag}
THEN t.name ELSE NULL END ) AS matchedTags
NULL AS matchedTags
FROM place p JOIN city c ON p.city_id = c.city_id LEFT JOIN place_tag pt ON p.place_id = pt.place_id LEFT JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.tag_id
WHERE c.name = #{city} AND p.category = #{category} AND p.latitude IS NOT NULL AND p.longitude IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.place_id, p.name, p.category, p.latitude, p.longitude
ORDER BY preferredTagScore DESC, banTagScore ASC, p.place_id ASC
